errors.text_span: няма ясна единица, но според легендата се отнася за трилиони долари
errors.evidence: The description states that the Y-axis has 'no clear unit' and then immediately states the unit according to the legend. This phrasing is contradictory and unclear. The legend clearly provides the unit 'в трлн. долара' (in trillion dollars).

errors.text_span: Графиката съдържа две линии: едната е синя
errors.evidence: The chart does not contain two lines. It contains a blue area chart representing 'Обобщени данни' (Aggregated data) and an orange line chart representing 'Ръст' (Growth). Describing the blue area as a line is a major structural error.

errors.text_span: оранжевата линия илюстрира намаляването на процентния ръст към 2023 година
errors.evidence: This is an over-generalization of the trend shown by the orange line. The percentage growth does not consistently decrease; it fluctuates, peaking at 19% in 2022 before dropping to 7% in 2023. The description misses this important peak.
